title: Review – let’s repeat!
intro: Let’s repeat everything we have learned so far.

learn.html: Today we repeat what we learned in the maktab. Say each du‘a out loud, then try the games below!

learn.title: 1️⃣ A‘udhu billah and Bismillah
learn.html: With these words we ask Allah, the Most Merciful, to protect us and to give us His mercy. We say them before every good deed.

learn.title: 2️⃣ The best creation
learn.html: The human being is Allah’s most beautiful and most perfect creation. We should live on Earth doing good and being thankful to Allah.

learn.title: 3️⃣ The maktab
learn.html: In the maktab the muallim (or muallima) teaches us about the Islamic religion, good manners and reading the Qur’an.

learn.label: Rabbi yassir
learn.ar: رَبِّ يَسِّرْ وَلَا تُعَسِّرْ رَبِّ تَمِّمْ بِالْخَيْرِ
learn.tr: Rabbi yassir wa laa tu‘assir, Rabbi tammim bil-khayr.
learn.en: My Lord, make it easy and do not make it hard. My Lord, complete it with good.

learn.label: Rabbi zidnee ‘ilmaa
learn.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

learn.title: 4️⃣ Our religion
learn.html: Islam is our religion. We are Muslims. We believe in Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (SAW), we tell the truth and we do good deeds.

learn.label: Allahu Rabbi
learn.ar: اللَّهُ رَبِّي، وَمُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيِّي، وَالْقُرْآنُ كِتَابِي، وَالْإِسْلَامُ دِينِي
learn.tr: Allaahu Rabbee, wa Muhammadun Nabiyyee, wal-Qur’aanu kitaabee, wal-Islaamu deenee.
learn.en: Allah is my Lord, Muhammad is my Prophet, the Qur’an is my book, Islam is my religion.

learn.label: The Shahadah
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluhu
learn.en: I believe and declare that only Allah is God, and I believe and declare that Muhammad is Allah’s servant and Messenger.

learn.title: 5️⃣ Salam
learn.html: Salam is the greeting of peace: As-salaamu ‘alaykum. We answer: Wa ‘alaykumus-salaam. It is lovely to add: wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu.

learn.title: 6️⃣ Water
learn.html: Allah made every living thing from water, so water is the source of life. The best water on Earth is Zamzam.

practice.title: Match the du‘a and its meaning
pairs: I seek Allah’s protection from Shaytan
My Lord, increase me in knowledge

practice.title: Allahu Rabbi in order
practice.prompt: Put the words in the right order.
items: Allaahu Rabbee – Allah is my Lord
wa Muhammadun Nabiyyee – Muhammad is my Prophet
wal-Qur’aanu kitaabee – the Qur’an is my book
wal-Islaamu deenee – Islam is my religion
